items.claim: Tasks online writes (PUT /:id, PATCH /:id/status, POST /batch/status) accept NO client revision token.
Reports online writes enforce a version-gated baseline (x-client-contract:v2 -> expectedUpdatedAt required; legacy only for unlocked non-scientific drafts).
Offline task sync: baseUpdatedAt optional; missing -> observed-ts CAS only; present+stale -> conflict.
Report offline enqueue (ReportEdit.tsx:358) sends data:{content} with NO baseUpdatedAt.
No first-party offline enqueue caller found for task ordinary fields or assigneeId (only status enqueues).
Server task row has updatedAt timestamp, no integer version column.
